title: Silver Swag Box Alternatives: 6 Boxes for Seniors - Cratejoy
summary: Compare six monthly gift boxes for seniors like Silver Swag Box by price, contents, and delivery, from care packages to puzzles and books.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Closest match for a mom or grandma


### Senior Joy Box vs Silver Swag Box


1st box


10% off


[Senior Joy Box Monthly Subscription Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/senior-joy-box-monthly-subscription-box-seniorjoybox) by Senior Joy Box


From $49.95 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/senior-joy-box-monthly-subscription-box-seniorjoybox)


**Best for:** Sending a mother or grandmother a themed monthly surprise.


Lindsay and Matt Daudistel started Senior Joy Box as a monthly gift box for moms, grandmas, and seniors. A spring box held a travel-size perfume, an artisan snack, a wellness item, and a small hands-on gift. June’s centered on a guided journal and a few comforts for reading and sleeping well.


#### What feels familiar


A new theme each month, with treats, a little pampering, and something to do, sent to someone you can’t visit as often as you’d like.


#### What changes


Its boxes are chosen with women in mind, so there’s no version for a grandfather or a couple. It’s sold one month at a time, with no prepaid plan.


A letter and photos in every box


### Grandbox vs Silver Swag Box


ships free


[Grandbox – Monthly Gift Box for Seniors](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/knife-subscription-box-survivalboxes) by Elastic Team


From $42.99 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/knife-subscription-box-survivalboxes)


**Best for:** A grandparent who will treasure your note and family photos as much as the gifts.


Grandbox sends five or six gifts around a monthly theme, from practical things to keepsakes, and every box includes a personalized letter or photo from you. Its own site says you can add up to four photos.


#### What feels familiar


Silver Swag’s Stay Connected card is there to start a conversation. Grandbox does that job with your own words and pictures, tucked into a themed monthly gift.


#### What changes


The listing doesn’t promise Silver Swag’s set mix of an activity, snacks, and a personal care item every month. A few reviews on its page are for the seller’s survival box, so read them with that in mind.


A puzzle to work on all month


### Puzzle Monthly vs Silver Swag Box


[Puzzle Monthly - Monthly Subscription](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/puzzle-monthly-monthly-subscription-puzzlemonthly) by Puzzle Monthly


From $32.92 / box


Ships fast


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/puzzle-monthly-monthly-subscription-puzzlemonthly)


**Best for:** The grandparent who always has a jigsaw spread across the card table.


A new 500- to 1,000-piece jigsaw puzzle arrives every month, and it’s theirs to keep. One reviewer’s mom works on hers while watching her favorite shows.


#### What feels familiar


The activity in a Silver Swag Box is sometimes a jigsaw, like the 750-piece puzzle in its January 2022 box. Puzzle Monthly sends that part every month.


#### What changes


It’s one puzzle, with no snacks, pampering, or card. The first one ships within 3 to 5 business days of your order, which helps with a birthday that snuck up on you.


A new book and a little pampering


### Peace & Pages vs Silver Swag Box


1st box


10% off


Best of 2024


[Peace & Pages Monthly Subscription](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/peace-pages) by Peace & Pages


From $24.75 / box


Low Stock


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/peace-pages)


**Best for:** A reader who would rather unwrap a good novel than a gadget.


Each box pairs a recent, well-reviewed book with relaxation items. Basic adds a full-size bath or body product and an aromatherapy item to the book. Deluxe adds a gift and a snack or drink on top of that.


#### What feels familiar


A monthly theme, something to do, and something to pamper with. The extras come from small US businesses.


#### What changes


The book takes the place of the puzzle or game, and you pick the genres from more than 10, Christian fiction among them, so the book suits their taste instead of leaving it to chance. Shipping is $6.99 on top, and orders placed by the 3rd make that month’s box.


Cozy comforts for staying in


### Relax and Unwind Hygge Haven vs Silver Swag Box


[Relax and Unwind Hygge Haven](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/relax-and-unwind-hygge-haven-universedelights) by UniverseDelights


From $54.99 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/relax-and-unwind-hygge-haven-universedelights)


**Best for:** Someone spending more evenings at home who would love a warm drink and something soft.


UniverseDelights fills this box with things for a cozy night in. The seller lists candles, fuzzy socks, hot cocoa, a throw blanket, a tea sampler, bath salts, and an adult coloring book among the possibilities, changing with the seasons.


#### What feels familiar


Silver Swag’s “Winter Retreat” box sent a lavender-scented heat pack, a shower steamer, and tea for a cozy January. This box makes that mood the whole subscription.


#### What changes


There’s no conversation card and no set activity beyond an occasional coloring book. If they live somewhere that doesn’t allow candles, message the seller before you order.


Faith, music, and cards to send


### Bette’s Box of Blessings vs Silver Swag Box


Preferred Seller


[Bette's Box of Blessings](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bettes-box-of-blessings) by Bette's Box of Blessings


From $29.99 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bettes-box-of-blessings)


**Best for:** A grandparent whose faith sits at the center of the week.


Each box is built around an encouraging theme, with Christian books, music, greeting cards, and other gifts. One reviewer uses the cards to send encouragement to people on their prayer list.


#### What feels familiar


Silver Swag Box is built around staying in touch. Here the greeting cards turn the recipient into the sender, with a reason to write to friends each month.


#### What changes


It’s openly Christian, so it suits someone who would welcome that. There are no snacks or personal care items.
